set.body:
Carry forward the existing engineering budgets and site-owned qualification gates. Local measurements can start during the first delivery tranche.

Acceptance criteria

1. The agreed workload and institutional envelope retain current-authority decisions while bounding transfer and directory costs. Evidence names fixture, sizes, rows, resources, latency, throughput and failures.
2. Signed guest and withdrawal events survive the supported recovery path. Restore permitted content and preserve ended access on independent replacement infrastructure.
3. The site owner records named custodian, retention or exclusion decisions, independent backup destination, measured recovery point/time, operator actions and disposition against agreed targets.

Verification

Reuse H04.2 and Q01.3 performance evidence, O04.2/O04.3 lifecycle evidence and the Q03.1 site operator drill. Site-dependent outcomes remain open until witnessed.

set.title: EP14: Qualify institutional-scale delivery and archival recovery
